reason: A Windows-focused launcher that automates starting DeepSeek Harness Web, checking its local status, opening it in the default browser, and maintaining a desktop shortcut.

summaries.zh: 用于一键启动 DeepSeek Harness Web、检查本地服务状态并在默认浏览器中打开界面的桌面启动插件。
summaries.en: A desktop launcher plugin that starts DeepSeek Harness Web, checks its local service status, and opens the UI in the default browser.

capabilities: Creates a launcher script and desktop shortcut
Starts the dsh web process under the user account
Checks a local loopback port for server status
Opens the local Web UI in the default browser
Provides install, open, and status actions through the web_launcher tool
